scope: Calibration of article naming/history, not independent generalization. Static authored inputs and both predictions fixed before Native; no speech-engine changes until both profiles finish. Native AX scope names and target geometry independently checked. inferredName is authored name-source metadata, not a measured VO private cache. Raw receipts/first predictions/failures immutable. No Navigation/State/Task accuracy or native speech-completion claim.

plan.question: Do unnamed article focus announcements depend on heading existence/location, explicit naming, nearest inner group, entry direction or prior article exposure? Fixed targets/commands, five one-factor naming/scope contrasts.
plan.hypothesis: Safari uses Native article name; Chrome begins with unnamed article and may use the focus target name on later entry. Observe without changing formatter or caller inputs until both profiles finish.
plan.inputPolicy: Authored DOM supplies static target/default semantics and per-browser expected article AX name; independently verify role/name/state/ancestor scopes and visible target geometry after each action. inferredName identifies absent explicit article name, never a target inferred from speech. Unused counts are placeholders. A mismatch stays a mismatch.
plan.attribution: Existing bounded receipt-window quality gate; no native completion guarantee. Collect both browsers before changes. All planned rows preserved. Calibration, not independent accuracy or Navigation/State/Task Success.
